_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/targets/test_one_per_player_capped.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_wastes_guard` is Protector of the Wastes' enters trigger: up to two targets, no two controlled by the same player -- a ceiling the card prints AND the different-controllers rule. `t_opp_trinket` and `t_opp_sigil` are a vanilla artifact and a vanilla enchantment to aim it at.

cards.name: Test Wastes Guard
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile up to two target artifacts and/or enchantments controlled by different players.
